text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Despite the changes to the territorial division law reached after talks with the ethnic-Albanian party of Democratic Prosperity, the Macedonian government does not offer a new municipal order in the country but an ethnic separation done according to the ambitioins of the ruling coalition.
- The breakout of polio in Albania should not raise concern. There is no risk of an epidemic in Macedonia, said health authorities that claim to have eradicated the illness from this region.

- Defense authorities will have to rigorously control the recruitment of soldiers and prepare the necessary groundwork for a professional, voluntary army. The authorities worried by the extremely high rate of military service evasion.

- Members of parliament are bound to get involved in the dispute about the jurisdiction of the capital, Skopje, over its five municipalities. The PDP is asking for the addition of a sixth ethnically Albanian municpality.
